record.title: SEC-registered clearing agency
kv: Exchange Act §17A; registration and applicable clearing rules
The entity performs securities clearing-agency functions.
National Securities Clearing Corporation (registered or chartered); Fixed Income Clearing Corporation (registered or chartered); The Depository Trust Company (registered or chartered)
Clearing agencies registered with the SEC for the relevant services
Registration must cover the entity and function. Identify CCP or depository service, asset and risk framework. Membership and transaction acceptance remain additional gates.
DTC’s registration does not make it the CCP for every service; the function must be identified.
National Securities Clearing Corporation: SEC lists NSCC as a registered clearing agency.
Fixed Income Clearing Corporation: SEC lists FICC as a registered clearing agency.
The Depository Trust Company: SEC lists DTC as a registered clearing agency.
